boone-county-public-library-hebron-branc.text: Hebron lists four study rooms, each for up to four people, with no room charge. Reserve by phone or in person only, or request a room at the customer service desk. Rooms are first come, first served and subject to BCPL’s Study Room Policy; availability and space for mobility equipment need confirming.

Study Rooms are available on a first-come, first-serve basis.
Request a study room at the customer service desk .
All requests are subject to our Study Room Policy .
